column3: Oh.{pause_20_skippable} It's you, {actor_name:1}.\nYou came back?{end_now}
Vale isn't quiet anymore.\nThe rain sees to that.{page_break}Still, I'm glad. Your\nmother, Dora, will be too.{end_wait}
Not for good? No.\nI suppose nobody stays.{end_wait}

I heard you were back.
I hoped the rumor was
wrong.{page_break}Will you tell us what
you saw out there?{end_wait}

{actor_name:1}! When did you
come back? After the
way you left,{page_break}I thought I'd never
see you again.{page_break}I'm glad. Truly.{end_wait}

Ow!{pause_20_skippable} It'll be years
before I'm grown up!
{actor_name:1}'s back already!{page_break}Oh... only visiting?
I thought the bad
things were over.{end_wait}

Welcome home, {actor_name:1}.
Oh...{pause_20_skippable} ...
What happened?{page_break}Why are you walking
with a girl who is not
{actor_name:6}?{end_wait}

Monsters have crowded
the roads since the
mountain burned.{page_break}The ash drives them
close to the village.
Weapons sell well.{page_break}If only our smiths
could make them
better...{end_wait}
I wish I knew the secret\nof good weapons. Then\nI might be of use.{end_wait}

I gave him a farewell
gift, thinking I'd
never see him again.{page_break}But here he is...{page_break}Where is {actor_name:6}? Wasn't
he to bring her back
with him?{end_wait}

I promised I'd be a
great blacksmith before
{actor_name:1} came back.{page_break}It's a man's promise.
I'm still working on
it.{end_wait}
That quiet girl with\n{actor_name:1}{pause_20_skippable} looks kind.\nI hope she is.{end_wait}
What happened to {actor_name:6}?\nHaven't you found\nher yet?{end_wait}
{actor_name:1}!{page_break}You've grown thin.\nI almost didn't\nrecognize you.{end_wait}
Oh. It's you, {actor_name:1}.\nYou came back.{end_wait}
You've come all the way\nhome to stay?\nAre you sure?{end_now}

Ah. You don't want to
settle into comfort.{page_break}Then you're welcome
here, for as long as
you stay.{end_wait}
Good. You've come a long\nway. Now go home\nand rest.{end_wait}

You went around the
eastern edge of the
continent?{page_break}You must be
exhausted.{end_wait}
At least the village\nhasn't changed. Be\nglad of that.{end_wait}
Does {actor_name:1} know that\nDora has fallen ill?{end_wait}

Maybe {actor_name:1} came back
because Dora can't hide
it anymore.{page_break}Only the mayor knows.
She asked us all not
to say.{end_wait}
Will {actor_name:1} go on\nwith the journey?\nIt must be hard.{end_wait}
Vale will wait.\nCome home whenever\nyou can.{end_wait}
Hey...{end_wait}
What?{end_wait}
Shouldn't we look\nfor {actor_name:2}?{end_wait}
Why?{end_wait}
{actor_name:1} still doesn't know\nabout Dora...{pause_20_skippable}right?\nSomeone should tell him.{end_wait}
You miss {actor_name:2}, don't\nyou? You're looking for\nan excuse to find him.{end_wait}
What? No! I just...{end_wait}
{text_effect:4}Guh...{pause_20_skippable}{pause_20_skippable} Gah...{pause_20_skippable} Ugh...{end_wait}
Grandma! What's the\nmatter? Are you\nchoking?{end_wait}
It's... It's {actor_name:2}!{end_wait}
She must miss\n{actor_name:2}, too...{end_wait}
No, it's really {actor_name:2}!\nLook, look!{end_wait}
{actor_name:2}!{end_now}
Oh, {actor_name:2}...!{end_now}
Mom, Dad...{pause_20_skippable} I'm home...{end_wait}
What,{pause_20_skippable} {actor_name:2}?{end_wait}
Oh, {actor_name:2}...!{end_wait}
Grandpa,\nI'm home...{end_wait}
Yes, yes...{pause_20_skippable} Did you\ncomplete your mission\nfor the Wise One?{end_now}
It is going well?\nThen you must go on\nsoon, I suppose.{end_wait}
Not yet? Then I'm glad\nyou're home, even for\na little while...{end_wait}
You're leaving again\nsoon...aren't you?{end_wait}
I'm just glad to see\nyou alive.{end_wait}
That's right.{end_wait}
Let me introduce you\nto my new friends.{end_wait}
Umm...{pause_20_skippable} I am {actor_name:3}.\nPleased to meet you.{end_wait}
I am {actor_name:4}, from Imil.\nI'm sorry we meet\nlike this.{end_wait}
Nice to meet you.\nPlease look after\nyoung {actor_name:2} for us.{end_wait}
Well{pause_20_skippable}, enough talk.\nRest. The roads are\nbad tonight.{end_wait}
That {actor_name:3} seems to be\na careful boy...{page_break}I wish you could be more\nlike {actor_name:3}, {actor_name:2}.{end_wait}
Did you hear us talking\nabout Dora just now?{end_now}

Dora told us not to
worry...that it's just
a fever.{page_break}Don't worry too much,
{actor_name:1}.{end_wait}
You didn't hear? But you\nlook worried.{page_break}We'll look after your\nmother. Go on, rest.{end_wait}
I hope the road didn't\nmake you sick.{page_break}{actor_name:2} never eats enough\nnow. His mother worries.{end_wait}
Young, with lovely\ngirls on the road...\nit must be nice.{end_wait}
His new friends are\npolite. That is the\nonly good news.{end_wait}

We shouldn't have talked
about Dora without
checking for {actor_name:1}.{page_break}I wish we could tell
him the truth.{end_wait}
{actor_name:2} has grown up\nfast on this road.\nToo fast.{end_wait}

{text_effect:4}Cough, cough{pause_20_skippable}{pause_20_skippable}! {reset_text_style}Who is it?{pause_20_skippable}\nIs it the innkeeper?{pause_20_skippable}{pause_20_skippable}\nIs it time to eat?{end_wait}
No? {text_effect:4}Cough...{reset_text_style}{pause_20_skippable}{pause_20_skippable}\nThen who{em_dash}{end_wait}
{actor_name:1}...{end_wait}
Are you finally home?\nHave you finished your\nmission!?{end_wait}
You haven't, have you?{end_wait}
Have you forgotten your\npromise, {actor_name:1}?{end_wait}
You promised you wouldn't\ncome back until your\nquest was done, right?{end_now}
You broke your promise\nbecause you were worried\nabout me?{end_wait}
You were more worried\nabout me than about\nyour promise?{end_wait}
Who told you I was ill?\nThe mayor? Or {text_effect:4}cough{reset_text_style}\n...was it the innkeeper?{end_now}
So you came because\nyou heard I was ill.{end_wait}
Are you telling me\nyou were shocked to\nsee me in bed?{end_wait}
You can't excuse a broken\npromise with worry for me.{page_break}{text_effect:4}Cough...{reset_text_style}{end_wait}
I... {text_effect:4}Cough...{reset_text_style}{pause_20_skippable}\nI just caught a\ncold. That's all.{end_wait}
But I'm fine now. {pause_20_skippable}{pause_20_skippable}\n{text_effect:4}Cough...{reset_text_style}{pause_20_skippable} Look!{end_wait}
See?{pause_20_skippable} I'm fine!{end_wait}
Don't worry about me.\nGo on. Finish your\nquest.{pause_20_skippable}{pause_20_skippable} Promise me.{end_wait}
Don't you worry about\nme. Finish your\nquest and come home.{page_break}{text_effect:4}Cough cough...{reset_text_style}{end_wait}

I'm sorry I was so
harsh, {actor_name:1}...{page_break}I'm so happy to see you.
Come home for good, when
you can...{end_wait}
{text_effect:4}Unn...{pause_20_skippable} Ohh...{pause_20_skippable}{pause_20_skippable}\nKyle...{pause_20_skippable} Don't go...{end_wait}
I think Dora\nis dreaming.{end_wait}
Kyle, watch out!{pause_20_skippable}{pause_20_skippable}\nThe boulder!!!{pause_20_skippable}\nThe boulder...{end_wait}
So you still haven't\nbrought {actor_name:6} home...{end_wait}
I recover from colds fast.{page_break}But Dora has been ill\na long time. That is not\na cold.{end_wait}
A sickness is going\naround. I should be\ncareful.{end_wait}
Will I see {actor_name:6}\nand {actor_name:5} again\nbefore I die?{end_wait}

Dora says it's a cold,
but she's been like this
ever since...{page_break}{actor_name:1} left...
She isn't getting
better...{end_wait}
Winter always brings\nsickness...{page_break}But this winter feels\nlonger than the others.{end_wait}

What was that "Alchemy"
that Kraden researched?{page_break}Perhaps it was
something better left
alone...{end_wait}
Earthquakes still strike\nonce in a while...{page_break}Every time, it gives me\nthe chills.{end_wait}
Even if the eruption\nwasn't Alchemy...{page_break}I don't want Kraden\nback in this village.{end_wait}
Every time the ground\nshakes, I think it's\nthe mountain again.{end_wait}

The mountain is still
throwing Psynergy
Stones about.{page_break}Travelers past the gate
say they've seen them
{page_break}by the roadside, under
the ash.{end_wait}
If the stones keep\nscattering...{page_break}Mt. Aleph will have\nnone left someday.{end_wait}
The northwest face of Mt.\nAleph was scorched by a\nriver of lava.{end_wait}
They say the lava looked\nlike the earth's insides\nhad spilled out.{end_wait}

The Great Healers are
too afraid to go to Sol
Sanctum anymore.{page_break}They have nothing to fear.
Their Psynergy should
protect them.{end_wait}
